sections.content: Combine the future with expressions of probability such as *probablemente*, seguramente, *quizá* and es *posible* *que*.

items.english: There will probably be more changes.

items.spanish: Es posible que la sociedad sea diferente.
items.english: It is possible that society will be different.

items.spanish: Quizá la gente trabajará menos horas en el futuro.
items.english: Perhaps people will work fewer hours in the future.
